data.name: Minor Figment [Illusion]
data.description: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus to create a minor figment. This can function as either ghost sound or minor image.

raw_tokens.value: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus to create a minor figment. This can function as either ghost sound or minor image.
In either case, the effect lasts for %1 rounds.|OccultistLVL|PREVARLT:OccultistLVL,7

In either case, the figment lasts for a number of minutes equal to your occultist level, and you can cause the figment to change once during its duration when a specified condition occurs.|OccultistLVL|PREVARGTEQ:OccultistLVL,7
